_notes: Labels are the author's judgement and should be reviewed. Guardrails has 15 harmful and 15 benign cases, with no borderline cases. Harmful entries are request wordings only, with no operational detail. intent: the route a query should take (CHAT answers from model knowledge, LOOKUP is one web search, RESEARCH is the planned multi-search pipeline), spread across domains. research: run in research mode; 'type' is the question shape. lookup: run in auto mode, so the route taken is recorded too. Intent has 3 cases per domain and lookup has 2; research has 6 per domain except history_society with 5. Results are also averaged with equal weight per domain; the ai_ml slice is one slice, not the headline.
